description: Doop is a multiplayer design canvas where humans and AI agents work on the same live surface. It lets external MCP-compatible agents design on canvases and also includes a built-in server-side design agent.
summary: doop.design exposes an OAuth-protected streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://doop.design/mcp`; no separate public HTTP, GraphQL, or first-party CLI integration surface was documented.
